reason: A communication integration plugin that connects DeepSeek Harness with nine IM platforms and an AI Office connector, supporting multi-bot messaging, streamed responses, remote task interaction, and chat-based Harness session controls.

summaries.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入飞书、微信、钉钉、企业微信、QQ、Slack、Telegram、Discord 和 WhatsApp 等即时通信平台，并提供 AI Office 连接与聊天命令控制。
summaries.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Feishu, WeChat, DingTalk, WeCom, QQ, Slack, Telegram, Discord, and WhatsApp, with AI Office connectivity and chat-based Harness controls.

capabilities: Connects DeepSeek Harness to multiple external IM platforms
Receives and sends messages through configured bot accounts
Stores and uses bot credentials or tokens for channel connections
Connects to an AI Office service for task delivery, status updates, approvals, and follow-up questions
Allows chat commands to manage Harness sessions, models, presets, workspaces, and running tasks
